label: Diagram 23
caption: Diagram 23  Foundation dimensions
description:
The image is a cross-sectional diagram titled "Diagram 23 Foundation dimensions". In the top left corner is the text "See para 2E2c". 

The central drawing shows a vertical wall resting on a wider, horizontal foundation block. Above the diagram, text reads "Wall should be central on foundation". Dimension lines above the foundation illustrate three segments: a central section directly under the wall labelled "W", flanked on either side by two outer segments each labelled "P". A vertical dimension line on the left side of the foundation indicates its depth or thickness, marked with the letter "T". Below the foundation, a horizontal dimension line indicates its overall width, with accompanying text reading "Foundation width should be not less than the appropriate dimension in Table 10". 

To the left of the main diagram, a text block states: "The minimum thickness of the foundation (T) should either be P or 150mm, whichever is greater". At the bottom left, a final line of text reads: "Trench fill foundations may be used as an alternative to strip foundations."
